0.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_ARDASHIR_000_000
0.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I was not expecting you to return so soon. Is...is something wrong?
0.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Non mi aspettavo che tornassi così presto. È... è successo qualcosa?

1.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_Q1_000_000
1.description: Tell him you wish to abandon your work on the anima?
1.translation_description: Dirgli che vuoi interrompere il tuo lavoro sul progetto Anima.

2.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_ARDASHIR_000_010
2.description: Of course, how silly of me! Though, for a moment, I was all but certain you wished to...to...
2.translation_description: Ma certo, che sciocco! Per un attimo, però, ero quasi certo che volessi... volessi...

3.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_ARDASHIR_000_011
3.description: Ahem. But should the time come that you decide you can no longer continue, I would understand.
3.translation_description: Ehm. Se mai dovesse arrivare il momento in cui non ti sentirai più in grado di continuare, lo capirò.

4.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_ARDASHIR_000_020
4.description: You need say no more. Far be it from me to deny you a well-earned respite. If and when you are willing to resume our research, I shall be here, ready and waiting.
4.translation_description: Non serve che tu dica altro. Non sarò certo io a negarti il meritato riposo. Quando sarai pronto a riprendere le ricerche, io sarò qui ad aspettarti.

5.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_ARDASHIR_000_030
5.description: Very well, then I shall take the anima glass for safekeeping.
5.translation_description: D’accordo, terrò il Vetro dell’Anima al sicuro.

6.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_ARDASHIR_000_031
6.description: If and when you are willing to resume our research, I shall be here, ready and waiting.
6.translation_description: Quando sarai pronto a riprendere le ricerche, io sarò qui ad aspettarti.

7.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_SYSTEM_000_001
7.description: Should you choose to abandon the quest “Born Again Anima,” the aetheric condensation of your anima weapon will be reset.
7.translation_description: Se decidi di abbandonare la missione «Anima rinata», la condensazione eterica della tua arma Anima verrà azzerata.

8.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_SYSTEM_000_002
8.description: Moreover, your progress will not be restored in the event you decide to undertake this quest again with the same job.
8.translation_description: Inoltre, se deciderai di intraprendere di nuovo questa missione con la stessa classe, i progressi non verranno ripristinati.

9.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_SYSTEM_000_003
9.description: Please be advised that this process cannot be reversed.
9.translation_description: Tieni presente che questa procedura è irreversibile.

10.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_Q1_000_010
10.description: Are you certain you wish to abandon the quest “Born Again Anima” and reset your progress?
10.translation_description: Vuoi davvero abbandonare la missione «Anima rinata» e azzerare i progressi?

11.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_SYSTEM_000_010
11.description: You may speak with Ardashir at any time should you decide to abandon this quest in the future.
11.translation_description: Se in futuro deciderai di abbandonare questa missione, potrai parlare con Ardashir in qualsiasi momento.

12.name: TEXT_JOBREL500QUESTLEAVE_00373_SYSTEM_000_020
12.description: You may speak with Ardashir at any time should you decide to undertake this quest in the future.
12.translation_description: Se in futuro deciderai di intraprendere questa missione, potrai parlare con Ardashir in qualsiasi momento.
